labels: []

---

## User problem / نیاز واقعی

What does a beginner or researcher need to do that is not supported today?

## Proposed behavior / رفتار پیشنهادی

Provide a clear example of input, expected output and acceptance criteria.

## Semantics and validation

For new indicators or strategy rules, define:
- exact formula and warmup;
- when the signal becomes available;
- entry/exit timing and TP/SL tie assumptions;
- how a synthetic deterministic regression test would prove correctness;
- whether any proprietary or license-restricted data/code is involved.

## Scope check

The current v0.1.1 engine is long-only, one-symbol, one-timeframe and local-first. Proposals should not be described as supported until implemented and tested.
